title: TC-PUB-001 — Vessel list returns public visible vessels
description: Verify GET /api/v1/vessels returns only public_visible vessels. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41.
preconditions: Backend running at http://localhost:8000. Database seeded with vessels (public_visible=true and false).
steps_actions: Send GET request to /api/v1/vessels without auth
steps_expected_result: Status 200, success=true, data is array, only public_visible vessels included, private vessels NOT in response

title: TC-PUB-002 — Vessel list supports search by name
description: Verify search by name filters results. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41.
preconditions: Database has vessel with name containing 'Merak' or 'EIRENE'.
steps_expected_result: Status 200, success=true, all results contain 'EIRENE' in name, non-matching vessels excluded

title: TC-PUB-003 — Vessel list supports search by MMSI
description: Verify search by MMSI filters results. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41.
preconditions: Database has vessel with MMSI containing '525'.
steps_expected_result: Status 200, success=true, results contain vessels with MMSI matching '525'

title: TC-PUB-004 — Vessel list supports pagination
description: Verify page and per_page parameters work. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41.
preconditions: Database has more than 5 public vessels.

title: TC-PUB-005 — Vessel list caps per_page at 100
description: Verify per_page is capped at 100. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41.

title: TC-PUB-006 — Vessel list supports operator_id filter
description: Verify operator_id filter returns only that operator's vessels. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41.
preconditions: Set testOperatorId to valid operator UUID.
steps_expected_result: Status 200, all results belong to the specified operator

title: TC-PUB-007 — Vessel list returns empty for non-matching search
description: Verify non-matching search returns empty array with 200. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41.
steps_expected_result: Status 200, success=true, data is empty array

title: TC-PUB-008 — Vessel list includes freshness field
description: Verify each vessel includes freshness field. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41.
preconditions: At least one public vessel has latest position.
steps_expected_result: Status 200, each vessel has freshness field with value LIVE, DELAYED, STALE, or OFFLINE

title: TC-PUB-009 — Vessel detail returns public vessel
description: Verify GET /api/v1/vessels/{id} returns vessel detail with evidence. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41. Bug history: JB-001.
preconditions: Set testVesselId to valid public vessel UUID.
steps_expected_result: Status 200, success=true, data.id matches UUID, data.name and data.mmsi present, evidence with data_source included

title: TC-PUB-010 — Vessel detail returns 404 for private vessel
description: Verify private vessel is not accessible via public API. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41.
preconditions: Set privateVesselId to vessel with public_visible=false.
steps_expected_result: Status 404, success=false, error.code=VESSEL_NOT_FOUND, private vessel data NOT exposed

title: TC-PUB-011 — Vessel detail returns 404 for non-existent UUID
description: Verify non-existent UUID returns 404. Requirement: API-004. JIRA: JB-41.

title: TC-PUB-012 — Latest positions returns all public vessel positions

steps_expected_result: Status 200, success=true, data is array, each position has vessel_id, latitude, longitude, freshness, source_timestamp

title: TC-PUB-013 — Latest positions supports bbox filter
description: Verify bbox filter works. Format: minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat. Requirement: API-005. JIRA: JB-42.

title: TC-PUB-014 — Latest positions excludes positions outside bbox

title: TC-PUB-015 — Latest positions ignores invalid bbox gracefully
